description: install-server.ts --print-only writes the engine result envelope (ok / filesPlanned / filesWritten / filesSkipped / errors / summary) to stdout rather than the planned server registration block (".mcp.json + .claude/settings.json" preview content). AC17 says --print-only 'prints the server registration block for the new .mcp.json + enabledMcpjsonServers shape', but the test (install-server.test.ts:84-91) only asserts the engine envelope, leaving the AC under-tested. Codex and Copilot both flagged this as a High break of the legacy --print-only contract for existing consumers; promoted to High via 3-way consensus.
suggestedFix: Either (a) update install-server.ts to compute the planned .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json content (e.g., via previewSettings + an analogous previewMcp) and print those JSON blocks; or (b) loosen AC17 wording to describe the engine plan envelope. If (a), extend install-server.test.ts to assert mcpServers['ralph-overview'] and enabledMcpjsonServers inside stdout.
